translations.literal: Prince Xiao of Qinghe, Qing; his mother was the Honored Lady Song.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Xiao of Qinghe, Liu Qing, was born to the Honored Lady Song.

translations.zh: 貴人，宋昌八世孫，扶風平陵人也。
translations.literal: The Honored Lady was an eighth-generation descendant of Song Chang, a native of Pingling in Fufeng.
translations.idiomatic: The Honored Lady was an eighth-generation descendant of Song Chang and came from Pingling in Fufeng commandery.

translations.zh: [一]父楊，以恭孝稱於鄉閭，不應州郡之命。
translations.literal: [One] Her father Yang was famed in the village lanes for respectful filiality and did not respond to summons from the province or commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Note [1]: Her father Yang was known in his home district for respectful filial piety and declined appointments from provincial and commandery authorities.

translations.zh: 楊姑即明德馬后之外祖母也。
translations.literal: Yang's aunt was the maternal grandmother of Empress Mingde Ma.
translations.idiomatic: Yang's aunt was the maternal grandmother of Empress Mingde Ma.

translations.zh: 馬后聞楊二女皆有才色，迎而訓之。
translations.literal: Empress Ma heard that Yang's two daughters both had talent and beauty; she welcomed them and instructed them.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Ma heard that Yang's two daughters were both gifted and beautiful, she brought them into her household and trained them.

translations.zh: 永平末，選入太子宮，甚有寵。
translations.literal: At the end of Yongping they were selected into the Heir Apparent's palace and were greatly favored.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Yongping era they were chosen for the crown prince's palace and won great favor.

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhang took the throne, both became Honored Ladies.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhang came to the throne, both sisters were made Honored Ladies.

translations.zh: 建初三年，大貴人生慶，明年立為皇太子，征楊為議郎，□賜甚渥。
translations.literal: In the third year of Jianchu the Senior Honored Lady bore Qing; the next year he was established as Imperial Heir Apparent; Yang was summoned as gentleman consultant; [lacuna in text] bestowals were very generous.
translations.idiomatic: In 78 CE, the third year of Jianchu, the Senior Honored Lady gave birth to Liu Qing; the next year he was made crown prince, Yang was summoned as a gentleman consultant, and imperial gifts were lavish—though one graph is missing in the received text.

translations.zh: 貴人長於人事，供奉長樂宮，身埶饋饌，太后憐之。
translations.literal: The Honored Lady was skilled in human affairs; she attended Changle Palace in person, personally presenting food; the empress dowager pitied her.
translations.idiomatic: The Honored Lady was adept at court affairs, personally serving at Changle Palace and presenting food with her own hands, and the empress dowager looked on her with affection.

translations.zh: 太后崩後，竇皇后寵盛，以貴人姊妹並幸，慶為太子，心內惡之。
translations.literal: After the empress dowager died, Empress Dou's favor flourished; because the Honored Lady and her sister were both favored and Qing was heir apparent, in her heart she hated them.
translations.idiomatic: After Empress Dowager Ma died, Empress Dou's influence grew. Because the Song sisters both enjoyed imperial favor and Liu Qing was crown prince, she inwardly resented them.

translations.literal: With her mother the Princess of Biyang she plotted to entrap the Song clan.
translations.idiomatic: She conspired with her mother, the Princess of Biyang, to destroy the Song family.

translations.zh: [二]外令兄弟求其纖過，內使御者偵伺得失。
translations.literal: [Two] Externally she had her brothers seek their minute faults; internally she had attendants spy on their gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: Note [2]: Outwardly she had her brothers hunt for the slightest fault; inwardly she set palace attendants to spy on the sisters' conduct.

translations.zh: [三]後於掖庭門邀遮得貴人書，云「病思生菟，令家求之」，因誣言欲作蠱道祝詛，以菟為厭勝之術，日夜毀譖，貴人母子遂漸見疏。
translations.literal: [Three] Later at the gate of the Rear Palace she intercepted and obtained a letter from the Honored Lady saying, 'Ill, I long for fresh hare; have the family seek one'; thereby she falsely charged that they wished to practice sorcery and curses, using the hare as an apotropaic technique; day and night she slandered them, and the Honored Lady and her son were gradually estranged.
translations.idiomatic: Note [3]: Later, at the harem gate, she intercepted a letter from the Honored Lady reading, "I am ill and crave fresh hare; have my family send one." On this pretext she accused them of witchcraft and cursing, claiming the hare was meant for an apotropaic rite. Night and day she slandered them until mother and son were gradually cast aside.
